About

Bangkok's Best-Kept Secret for Nuru, Soapy & Erotic Massage

Lucky Cat is where Bangkok gentlemen come when they want something real not just a name on a sign, but a session they’ll still be thinking about on the flight home.

More Than Just a Massage

We built this place for men who’ve already tried the tourist traps and the overpriced Sukhumvit spots, and came away wanting more. What you’ll find here is a clean, private space, a lineup of therapists who actually know what they’re doing, and a management team that takes the whole experience seriously from the moment you contact us to the moment you leave.

What Makes Us Different

A lot of places in Bangkok compete on price. We compete on experience.

  • Professionally Trained Therapists
  • Professionally trained and dedicated to delivering a smooth, unhurried experience.
  • Unique Seasonal Uniforms
  • Seasonal themed outfits and premium stockings create a uniquely captivating atmosphere.
  • Hygiene & Peace of Mind
  • Exceptional cleanliness and regular health screenings for your comfort, confidence, and peace of mind.
  • Spacious Private Rooms
  • Spacious private rooms with a comfortable, welcoming atmosphere and complete privacy.
